job: Confirm something that already happened, then get out of the way.
purpose: A short message at the bottom right (bottom centre on phones) that stacks, fans out on hover and fades. Created with toast({ title, description, tone, action }); toast.promise follows a promise. It never asks a question. Toasts last 5 seconds, 8 for errors; loading lasts until settled. The stack is a polite live region.
useWhen: An action finished and needs a quiet receipt: key copied, saved, deleted.
Something finished elsewhere: a crawl completed, a webhook failed.
A long task needs a loading toast that turns into the result.

avoidWhen.when: The reader must choose or confirm something.
A persistent warning next to content.
A notice about the whole account.
A list of past events to read later.

states.name: expanded
states.how: data-expanded when the stack fans out on hover; timers pause

states.name: swiped
states.how: data-swiping and data-swiped while a toast is dragged sideways

states.name: loading
states.how: tone loading shows a spinner until toast.update or toast.promise settles

variants.useWhen: A limit or a risk to read.
News the reader did not trigger.
An accent receipt that is not a state.
The newest toast at the front of the stack.
A toast tucked behind the front three.

parts.role: The stack, a manual popover and live region.
The thin line showing the time left.

keyboard.does: Reaches the action and close buttons of a toast.
